articles.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploit BeyondTrust Zero-Day to Take Over Remote Support Servers
articles.executive_summary: China-linked hackers exploited a zero-day vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support to take over remote support servers, posing a significant risk to enterprise networks. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-102764, has a CVSS score of 9.3, indicating a critical severity.
articles.technical_breakdown: The vulnerability is caused by improper origin validation in an internal messaging component, allowing attackers to exploit it as a zero-day. The exploit was used to take over remote support servers, providing attackers with unauthorized access to sensitive systems.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the patch for CVE-2026-102764 as soon as possible
Implement network segmentation to contain affected systems
Monitor for suspicious activity related to the vulnerability
articles.telegram_snippet: China-linked hackers exploited a zero-day in BeyondTrust Remote Support, taking over remote support servers with a CVSS score of 9.3. Apply the patch immediately to mitigate the risk.

articles.title: F-Secure Launches Victim-First Scam Encyclopedia Covering 50+ Types of Consumer Fraud
articles.executive_summary: F-Secure has launched a scam encyclopedia to educate consumers about various types of fraud, aiming to empower victims with knowledge to avoid falling prey to emerging cyber crimes. The resource is built from decades of threat intelligence research and covers over 50 types of consumer scams.
